summary_en: On October 14, 2026, the company resolved to acquire 30,000 shares (0.37% of outstanding shares) at 1,470 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3, with a total acquisition limit of 44.1 million yen and settlement on October 15, 2026. The acquisition aims to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible capital policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 14, 2026, SANKO TECHNO's board of directors resolved to acquire 30,000 shares of treasury stock via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours trading system) on October 15, 2026. The acquisition will be executed at 1,470 yen per share, the closing price on October 14, with a total acquisition limit of 44.1 million yen. This represents 0.4% of outstanding shares (7,921,369 shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026).

The acquisition order will be placed at 8:45 a.m. on October 15 for execution during that specific trading session, with no flexibility to change the trading method or timing. The company stated that while the number of shares to be acquired will not be changed, there is a possibility that some or all of the acquisition may not be executed depending on market conditions.

The company's stated purpose is to improve capital efficiency and to enable flexible capital policy in response to changing business circumstances. Settlement is expected following the 8:45 a.m. trading session, with results to be announced after execution.
